methodology.clock: One Python time.monotonic_ns clock for command start, complete expected paint-record validation and command return.
methodology.deadline: Original driver remaining deadline is captured when the collector is constructed; watch setup and begin cannot restart it.
methodology.input: Existing owned-window XTest/xdotool path; pointer movement and geometry preparation precede click timing.
methodology.runtimeParity: Solid and React use the same generated production-framework module in Bun development execution and machine-code AOT compilation; native host is the same exact prebuilt development-profile binary in all 12 cases.
methodology.trials: One qualification case for each core/Solid/React, development/AOT and click/input combination. No failed native case was rerun; all 12 passed on their first execution.
methodology.text: The interval includes the whole offered text/key schedule and subsequent native/app scheduling, not per-keystroke latency.
methodology.interpretation: Observed before command return demonstrates removal of the old command-completion observation floor. Values are diagnostic upper bounds, not a cross-framework comparison.
methodology.aot: Each executable has a compiled-program record; the pinned feature record identifies JIT unused with 27 removed JIT ranges. The interpreter remains present. Driver --mode alone is not AOT proof.
methodology.screenshots: All six AOT after screenshots were inspected. Click counters and Solid/React keyed order matched; typed text appeared, with the long core nonce clipped by the input viewport. Complete values were independently checked in native records.

safetyControls.result: 63 tests passed, no skips, with ResourceWarning treated as an error.

deadlineNegative.description: Fixed-clock controls retained the original two-second remaining interval and expired either before begin or after begin before a complete matching record. Both incorrectly succeeded on the previous implementation and reject after the fix.

nonFiniteExponentNegative.description: A matching record with an extra 1e999 or -1e999 field must fail; finite 1e308 remains accepted. The original collector accepted overflow to Python infinity.

limitations: Native host is a development-profile binary, not release-performance qualification.
XTest input and Mesa llvmpipe do not establish physical input or hardware GPU behavior.

Record observation includes command startup, OS/app/native scheduling, paint instrumentation, log I/O and reader validation; it is not an OS delivery, GPU completion or display presentation timestamp.
Core and framework fixtures differ in tree size; a single trial per scenario cannot rank adapters or establish a latency budget.
The collector is Linux-only. No macOS or Windows native input capability is qualified here.

Raw reports, logs, binaries, source maps and screenshots remain in the task evidence archive. This compact record preserves their hashes, matched raw paint records and exact source/artifact identities; it does not embed executables or images.
